summary: Wallet and phone pickpocketed on the Paris metro
story: On August 26 my wallet and phone were taken from my zipped crossbody bag on line 1 of the Paris metro, somewhere between Chatelet and the Louvre. I noticed at the museum entrance. I went to the police station near the Louvre that afternoon and they took my statement, but they said the printed report would take several days and I flew home before it was ready. The reference number they gave me is 2026/PV/093317. I am claiming the phone and the wallet. The cash in the wallet was about $60.
